meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会获得两个新工具:用 Tavily 做网络搜索、提取网页内容,全程不需要 API key。免费额度用完时,它会引导你通过 OneCLI 创建密钥升级。
howto.when: 当你想为某些代理组安装 Tavily 网络搜索或 URL 提取功能,并且没有 API key 时,这个技能会启动;在 keyless 配额耗尽时也会接管,引导升级。

say.text: 帮我用 Tavily 搜索量子计算的最新进展。
say.note: 调用 Tavily 搜索,返回结果。

say.text: 用 Tavily 提取 https://example.com 的正文内容。
say.note: 调用 Tavily 提取工具获取网页内容。

say.text: 我的 Tavily 免费额度用完了,帮我设置 API key 升级。
say.note: 启动升级流程,引导创建密钥并重新注册。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude gains two new tools: Tavily web search and URL content extraction, both without an API key. When the keyless allowance runs out, it guides you to create and store an API key via OneCLI to upgrade.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to install Tavily web search or URL extraction for agent groups without an API key. Also handles the upgrade flow once the keyless quota is exhausted.

say_en.text: Use Tavily to search for the latest progress in quantum computing.
say_en.note: Calls Tavily search and returns results.

say_en.text: Use Tavily to extract the content from https://example.com
say_en.note: Calls the extract tool to fetch page content.

say_en.text: My Tavily keyless allowance is gone; help me set up an API key to upgrade.
say_en.note: Starts the upgrade flow to create a key and re-register.
